claim: For every graph G and cardinal kappa, if the edge set of G is not the union of kappa triangle-free subgraphs then the chromatic number of G exceeds 2^kappa; in particular any graph that is not a union of countably many triangle-free subgraphs has chromatic number and vertex cardinality strictly above the continuum.

facets.entities: infinite simple graphs and their edge sets
facets.mechanism: binary coding of a proper vertex colouring by 2^kappa colours into kappa Boolean coordinates, one bipartite hence triangle-free layer per coordinate
facets.method: cardinal exponentiation bound relating triangle-free cover number to chromatic number
facets.outcome: chromatic, vertex and edge cardinality lower bound above the continuum for any Erdos problem 595 witness
